ja.title: ダイバラシブ400 mgの減量を肺がんと大腸がんの公開奏効データから考える
ja.summary: KRAS G12C阻害薬ダイバラシブについて、第1相の公開された用量群の奏効と400 mgの定常状態の薬物動態から曝露反応を推定し、仮想患者4,096人で200 mgと400 mgを肺がんと大腸がんで比べる。
ja.seo_title: ダイバラシブ200 mgと400 mgの曝露比較

en.title: Divarasib 200 versus 400 mg from grouped response data
en.summary: Exploratory exposure–response modeling contrasts divarasib doses in lung and colorectal cancer, with uncertain dose mixtures and no dose-specific safety model.
en.seo_title: Divarasib 200 vs 400 mg: grouped response data
en.seo_description: Exploratory exposure–response modeling contrasts divarasib doses in lung and colorectal cancer, with uncertain dose mixtures and no dose-specific safety model.

english.title: Can divarasib 400 mg be lowered? Estimating exposure-response in lung and colorectal cancer from published dose-group responses
english.summary: A Japanese technical note that combines published phase I dose-group response counts with 400 mg steady-state PK of the KRAS G12C inhibitor divarasib to estimate exposure-response and compare 200 and 400 mg in 4,096 virtual patients for NSCLC and CRC.
